**Finding submitted: deviation on Section 4.4 (Audit Rights), cured to the fallback position.**

- **Investigation:** Section 4.4 is the only audit/inspection right binding Corio; searches and review of Exhibit B (Pricing, Revenue Sharing Fees) and Section 17 (Payment Terms) turned up no other verification, records-inspection or system-access mechanic.
- **Already at/above playbook level:** once per calendar year, independent CPA reasonably acceptable to us, Commerce One bears inspection costs, and no direct access to our systems.
- **Fallback failures cured:** "reasonable notice" replaced with fifteen (15) days' prior notice; cost-shifting trigger moved from a 5% underpayment to more than 10%.
- **Not pursued:** preferred-only extras (business hours, confidentiality-bound auditor, off-site where possible) — noted in the rationale rather than redlined.
